english: This is the enemy's main force, desu~?
Whoa, there were this many!?
There… my black self…!!
Gandalfr… just a little longer…\nI will… have you…!
Huh? Gandhara? The land of love?
That's wrong, nyu.
If she fires off explosions in succession,\nbuildings will be rubble in an instant.\nOpen-field combat is our only option.
Right. Though it's plenty dangerous here too!
Miss Vallière,\nhave you remembered anything at all\nabout Gandalfr?
…I've been thinking about it ever since.\nBut I can't remember what kind of person it was —\nnot the form, not the voice, nothing.
And yet, why is it?\nI keep thinking about that person.\nUnconsciously trying to remember.
The Left Hand of God, Gandalfr — the Void's familiar.\nAnd probably, my familiar.
My black self is trying to kill me\nto meet Gandalfr.
If I die, unable to summon a familiar,\na new bearer of the Void will be chosen.\n…That's her aim.
If you understand, then die!\nWithout Gandalfr,\nyou're worthless!
And what about you?\nYou don't have a familiar either!
Right, I don't have Gandalfr either.\nSo this world might as well\nvanish!!
What are you saying!!
But there's a chance.\nA chance that if you die, a new bearer of the Void\nwill summon Gandalfr…
That's why I'll kill you!
Coming at us with her bloodlust this bare…\nshe's not quite sane!
She has her reasons for being that desperate.\nLouise, if you clash with half-hearted resolve,\nyou'll be killed for sure.
I know.
But don't worry.\nI have one too.\nA reason I can't lose…!
Where!! Where is Koto!!
Nyo!? A scary one showed up, nyo!!
Like you can see, Koto ain't here!\nGo look somewhere else!
Humans are all liars!\nHumans! Humans!\nJust kill them alllll!!
Good grief, this is insane!\nAt a time like this!
Kill!
Kill them all!!
Uu… I-I'm scared…
Do not fear.\nA true killer does not say 'kill'.\nThey've finished the killing before saying it.
In other words, those who say 'kill'\nare not used to the act.
Put another way,\nthey're those who cannot strike a vital point\nwithout words to spur on their bloodlust…
Without words to spur herself on…?\nYes, I thought so…
What do you mean, 'thought so'?
Everyone! Leave my black self to me!
Miss Vallière…
You sure you're okay?
Sorry, but I want to do this one-on-one.\nHandle the rest, please.
What are you planning at a time like this, desu~?
You've got some idea, right?
There's something I need to confirm.\nBuy me a little time!
Understood. Beginning Louise's support!\nThose who can spare it, help!
If only Koto were here!\nThe rest would work itself out!
Why don't you just wait in Kyouto!
Shut up!\nThis is all humanity's fault!\nIf only humans had perished!
Ain't that just a false accusation!
You know nothing! Nothing!
Then, what is it you know?
The end.
'The end' alone\ntells me nothing, nyo!
Not understanding is fine.\nNo need for more people\nto know such a thing.
I'll eliminate interfering humans.\nI have no intention of showing mercy.\nAnyone who knows the end would do the same…!
So this is really the end…
I thought you couldn't die\nno matter what…
Hehe… the end had long since come…\nShall I say I simply kept moving\nanyway?
What do you mean, nyo!?
Who knows?
Ah… she vanished…
What could 'the end' mean…?
Think later.\nThere's still something that must be done first!
Coming all this way just to be killed.
Is that so?\nMages are worse at close combat, aren't they.
There are plenty of ways.
More importantly, there's something I want to confirm.\nYou — do you love Gandalfr?
Answer properly.
You love him, don't you.
You want to meet him even if it means killing me.\nThat's not for the world's sake —\nit's personal, strong emotion, isn't it.
So what if it is!
You admitted it.
I won't choose my means for my goal!\nNo — I can't choose!
Would Gandalfr be happy about that?
Would the person you long to meet so much\nrejoice at such methods?
That's…!!
I would never sacrifice people\nto fulfill my own wishes!
I couldn't forgive myself for that, and\nI'd never love someone\nwho'd love me for it!
I don't know what Gandalfr is like —\nnot his form, not his voice, not his personality, nothing.
But if he's someone special to me,\nsomeone irreplaceable,\nthere's one thing I do know.
Even if Gandalfr is alive somewhere\nand fated never\nto meet me,
he's surely fighting somewhere\nto protect someone's happiness, getting hurt,\naiming for the best future!
If he's not that kind of familiar, I don't want him!
Louise the Zero's familiar of Zero\nis the greatest familiar there is!
Louise-san's magic…!!
Tch… shut up shut up shut up!!\nI WILL meet Gandalfr!
Repent! The you of now\nhas no right to meet Gandalfr!
My feelings… losing…
You were strong.\nBut one-sided feelings alone, you know.
A familiar and a mage only show\ntheir true power when their hearts connect.
…Maybe. But there's no time.\nFor me, or for you.
Huh? No time, what?
There's no time for you to meet Gandalfr.\nMy time simply ran out\na little sooner than yours… that's all.
What does that mean!
The future is decided… the end is near.\nThere's… no hope.
She vanished…
(Again… again, as if knowing the future,\nspeaking of the end…)
No time… what does that mean…?
Post-battle perimeter watch complete.\nNo abnormalities.
Whew, can we relax now?
We should stay alert.\nNow it's about the Hinamizawa\nand Black Fund teams.
In the end, what were those black people?
Hard to call 'em human.\nVanishing without a trace and all.
But they had something like hearts,\njust like us, nyo.
What's wrong, Soniko-san?
I-I also couldn't think of them\nas filming or CG at all… I wonder\nif I should have talked with them more…
I feel the same as Soniko-san.\nThey seemed strong yet weak…\nThat felt so human.
They never revealed what they were, to the end.
That's what bothers me most.
If even fighting for their lives,\nthey still needed to hide what they were,\nthen what was the reason.
It's unnatural, desu~.
Come to think of it, where's Louise, nyu?
Please leave her alone a little.\nShe just faced and fought herself.
Gandalfr… the Left Hand of God, Gandalfr.
Every time I speak that name, my chest aches.\nI think I understand why.
I love Gandalfr.
Hopelessly, I'm sure…
I don't even know who or where he is.\nAnd yet, I love him…
I always wondered if that was possible,\nbut I'll believe\nin this feeling.
'The future is decided, there's no hope'…\nthat's what she said as she vanished, but\nI'll seize a hopeful future for sure.
If this feeling is real,\nif there's someone I feel this strongly for,\nwe'll meet someday. I'll believe that…!
Right, Gandalfr?\nYou whom I've yet to meet…
──The next morning
What a nice morning, nyo~!
You're up early, Dejiko.
Didn't YOU\nhave trouble sleeping, nyo?
Hmm, well.\nI had quite a nice dream, actually.
Hoho, what kind of dream, nyo?\nOne where Gandalfr-san\ndotes on you, nyo?
Wha—! No!!\nThat's not what I'd call a nice dream!
Then what kind of dream, nyo? Tell me, nyo!
Um, a dream where things somehow go well.\nOur battle ends with a good result!
That's a lucky dream, nyo.
Maybe it was Gandalfr\nwho showed me that dream.
So it was just lovey-dovey talk after all, nyo…
No it's not!!
Good morning!\nEhehe~ — everyone seems to be having fun♪\nDid something happen?
Soniko, perfect timing, nyo.\nLouise was just…
Don't spread it around!
It means we're at peace, nyu.
Puchiko!? You were here too!?
That our commotion is about such things\nmeans we protected Akihabara.\nCan't we be a little happy about that?
That's right.\nI happened to overhear while\nsweeping the street.
I-I did too…
Y-you guuuyyyys!!
'Louise is living the dream,' got it. Memo memo.
What's 'living the dream'!?
It means you've got a man, nyu.
I don't!!\nIf you spread weird rumors I won't forgive you!!
I'll tell everyone when we regroup, nyo~!
Wait!!\nI'll silence you by force if I have to!!
What's with the ruckus in the morning…
Ah!\nDejiko-chan's being chased by Louise-san!\nNo fair! Me too, me too!!
As long as this liveliness lasts, we'll be fine no matter what.\nI believe so, and unexpectedly,\nit seems I like this liveliness.
Hmm. I like Siesta's cooking\nbetter than liveliness.
You work for what you eat, remember?\nHehe, seems you won't be leaving for a while either.
//END
